prHeader: Automated dependency update from Renovate. Merging is gated on CI passing (tests, lint, type checks, govulncheck, bun audit, CodeQL).

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and lockfile-only updates for any dependency. These almost never change behaviour and have the smallest blast radius.
Auto-merge minor and patch updates for devDependencies. Dev tooling churn is low-risk because it never ships in the runtime artifact.
Hold minor updates for runtime dependencies for manual review. Behaviour changes are possible and we want eyes on them.
All major updates require manual review and approval via the Dependency Dashboard. Holding majors prevents surprise breakage from a maintainer's weekend release.
Group all GitHub Actions updates into one PR per run. Cuts noise — actions are usually trivial bumps.
Group Go toolchain and golang.org/x updates. These move together and are noisy when split.
Group Astro + Cloudflare tooling for the website. They evolve in lockstep.
Group Svelte ecosystem updates for the frontend.
Group Tailwind + DaisyUI updates. They are often released together and tested together.
Pin the Go runtime version explicitly — major Go bumps need manual review because they can change build flags and language features.
